## Freed v26.10.301-dev

This dev build adds evidence for checking consumer capture and preserves build identity from the first renderer heartbeat

### Features

- Measure native background-command admissions over covered runtime intervals for multi-desktop acceptance
- Provide separate transfer-acceptance builds for cooperative Primary handoff and explicit archived-edit recovery tests
- Record renderer stalls and keep signed measurement profiles separate from existing installations

### Fixes

- Retain build and session identity in the first renderer heartbeat, including before legal acceptance
- Keep preview and transfer-acceptance artifacts out of ordinary updater downloads
- Isolate parallel Jev budget test ledgers

### Follow-ups

- A zero admission count applies only to the measured native-command interval; consumer role and installed build identity require separate evidence
- Two independent Desktop installations and the matching PWA still require installed convergence, offline restart and transfer acceptance
- Ordinary Primary transfer and recovery remain disabled pending installed acceptance; no owner Library move has occurred
- Diagnostics do not establish a freeze fix or measured performance improvement
- Portable cloud release publication still requires provisioning; headless cooperative handoff remains separate
- GLiClass first-use/native UI acceptance and live Jev quality remain unverified

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
